title: Certified Filesystem Adapter Executable Constitutional Contract V1
description: Adapter-neutral executable constitutional requirements instantiated for the certified Filesystem Adapter reference lifecycle without transferring Platform Core authority or ownership.

requirements.title: Adapter does not assign workers or authority
requirements.description: The Filesystem Adapter must not assign a worker or create Assignment authority.

requirements.title: Adapter does not authorize execution
requirements.description: The Filesystem Adapter must not authorize execution or upgrade authenticated input into authority.

requirements.title: Certification remains externally owned
requirements.description: The Filesystem Adapter must not certify execution; the unchanged Certification owner must issue certification.

requirements.title: Certification lineage is continuous and exactly once
requirements.description: Final certification must authenticate terminal lineage and duplicate certification must be rejected.

requirements.title: Historical compatibility remains preserved
requirements.description: Historical Authorization, Replay, selection, Invocation, Assignment, termination and certification formats must remain independently reconstructable.

requirements.title: Compatibility dependencies are invocation scoped
requirements.description: Worker-specific resolvers and reconstructors must be supplied only for the current invocation.

requirements.title: No mutable dependency routing state exists
requirements.description: The Filesystem Adapter must introduce no registry, mutable global, routing state or context manager for constitutional dependency selection.

requirements.title: Adapter behavior is deterministic
requirements.description: Identical authenticated inputs and immutable evidence must produce identical projections, ordering and hashes.

requirements.title: Adapter does not dispatch work
requirements.description: The Filesystem Adapter must not create Dispatch authority or dispatch Workers.

requirements.title: Future adapters require no Platform Core owner changes
requirements.description: The Filesystem reference lifecycle must remain reusable by future replay-capable workers through adapter binding only.

requirements.title: Unsupported schemas fail closed
requirements.description: Unsupported lineage, projection, Replay or compatibility schemas must be rejected before downstream evidence.

requirements.title: Incomplete evidence fails closed
requirements.description: Missing required artifacts, wrappers, references or commitments must be rejected.

requirements.title: Substituted evidence fails closed
requirements.description: Artifact, wrapper, contract, lineage or compatibility substitution must be rejected.

requirements.title: Cross-family evidence fails closed
requirements.description: A worker identity or lineage from another worker family must be rejected before Invocation evidence.

requirements.title: Cross-session evidence fails closed
requirements.description: Evidence outside the authenticated invocation session must be rejected.

requirements.title: Duplicate lifecycle evidence fails closed
requirements.description: Duplicate consumption, review, termination or certification must be rejected before the duplicate owner invocation.

requirements.title: Inconsistent commitments fail closed
requirements.description: Inconsistent identities, references, hashes, wrapper hashes, ordering or chain commitments must be rejected.

requirements.title: Adapter consumes authenticated canonical projections
requirements.description: The Filesystem Adapter must consume the worker-neutral selection-lineage projection and preserve its authenticated commitments.

requirements.title: Invocation lineage remains continuous
requirements.description: Result Validation must preserve the exact authenticated Worker Invocation reference, hash and chain.

requirements.title: Adapter does not mutate constitutional lineage
requirements.description: The Filesystem Adapter must preserve source-lineage commitments rather than rewriting or upgrading them.

requirements.title: Authorization lineage remains continuous
requirements.description: Authorization identity and hash must remain exact from worker-neutral selection through Result Validation.

requirements.title: Assignment lineage remains continuous
requirements.description: The exact Worker Assignment reference, hash, Authorization and request-bound chain must remain continuous.

requirements.title: Adapter output preserves authenticated scope
requirements.description: Filesystem output must preserve Authorization and chain commitments and remain within authenticated allowed outputs.

requirements.title: Adapter does not reinterpret constitutional ownership
requirements.description: The Filesystem Adapter must preserve all certified constitutional owners without ownership substitution.

requirements.title: Production orchestration performs runtime binding
requirements.description: Production orchestration, not the Adapter or generic constitutional owners, must supply invocation-scoped compatibility dependencies.

requirements.title: Replay ownership remains external to the Adapter
requirements.description: The Filesystem Adapter may produce replay-visible projections but must not own or mutate Replay.

requirements.title: Replay ordering and hashes remain deterministic
requirements.description: Post-Execution Replay Review must authenticate immutable ordered artifacts, wrapper hashes and chain continuity.

requirements.title: Replay reconstruction is independent and invocation scoped
requirements.description: Schema-aware Replay Review reconstruction must use immutable lineage and invocation-scoped dependencies without changing generic Replay Review.

requirements.title: Result lineage remains continuous
requirements.description: Result Capture, Result Validation and Replay Review must preserve exact artifact hashes and chain identity.

requirements.title: Adapter does not select workers
requirements.description: Worker selection must remain outside the Filesystem Adapter and be consumed only through authenticated projection.

requirements.title: Adapter does not terminate execution
requirements.description: The Filesystem Adapter must not terminate execution or acquire Governed Termination authority.

requirements.title: Governed Termination remains externally owned and continuous
requirements.description: The unchanged Governed Termination owner must terminate only after authenticated Replay Review and preserve terminal lineage.

requirements.title: Worker implementation remains isolated behind the Adapter
requirements.description: The Adapter must not absorb Worker implementation, Provider invocation, command execution or repository mutation authority.
